# glinet_hardware_acceleration (Resource)

Manage the stock MediaTek hardware acceleration settings. Per-queue sections are not managed by this resource.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `acc_type` (String) Acceleration type reported by the firmware.
- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable hardware acceleration.
- `hqos` (Boolean) Enable hardware QoS.
- `scheduling` (String) Queue scheduling algorithm.
- `txq_num` (Number) Transmit queue count.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
